start: The 03:00 India-time Cron Trigger fires; KV binding BACKUP is set

steps.action: The backup runs first: one call to the gym server for one copy of all gym data
user_sees: Log '[backup] stored' with the day, size and parts
must_not: The clean-up running before the copy

steps.action: The copy is stored in parts under the India day, the meta last, each with a 7-day expiry
must_not: A copy kept longer than 7 days
The meta written before every part is stored

steps.action: The nightly clean-up and the billing check run after it
user_sees: Both run even when the backup failed
must_not: The clean-up skipped because the backup failed

start: A night when the copy is bigger than one KV value (over 20 MB)

steps.action: The copy is cut into 20 MB parts without being read
user_sees: KV keys snap/<day>/part/0, part/1 ... and meta with parts: <n>
must_not: A part over the 25 MiB KV limit

user_sees: Log '[backup] off: no BACKUP binding ...' and nothing stored
must_not: A crash that stops the clean-up

steps.action: The gym server lacks update 0052, or does not answer
user_sees: KV status { ok: false, error: 'NOT_READY: migration 0052 not applied' } or 'gym server answered <code>'

steps.action: The copy does not end in a closing brace (cut short)
user_sees: KV status error 'copy looks incomplete (<n> bytes)'
must_not: A cut-off copy stored as good

steps.action: A night fails after a good night
user_sees: Status ok false, lastGoodAt still the good night
must_not: lastGoodAt wiped by the failed night

user_sees: Copies older than 7 days are gone by themselves

start: A member deleted their account yesterday

steps.action: Last night's copy still holds the member
user_sees: The copy expires within 7 days of being taken, so within 7 days of the deletion
must_not: A copy with the member kept past 7 days
The copy readable by anyone without the Cloudflare account

start: The watch workflow (or the owner) asks /backup/status the morning after a good night

user_sees: Answer { setUp: true, lastRunOk: true, lastGoodAt: <time>, fresh: true }
must_not: Any gym name, size or count in the answer

start: The status asked in a wrong way or before set-up

must_not: fresh true when nothing is stored

user_sees: Not answered as status: HQ sign-in is asked
must_not: The status changed by a public call

start: Just deployed, no night yet, then nights go by

steps.action: Ask the status the first time
user_sees: fresh true, and the waiting time is remembered
must_not: An alarm on the day of the deploy

steps.action: No good copy for more than 30 hours
user_sees: fresh false; the watch opens an issue
must_not: fresh true after 30 hours with no good copy
